general.shortcutCaption: Press it in any app, then speak
general.shortcutError: Couldn't use that shortcut. Try another.
general.autoCaption: Hold to talk, or tap to keep recording until you tap again
general.holdCaption: Hold to talk, release to paste
general.toggleCaption: Tap to start, tap again to paste
general.cleanAndReformatCaption: Removes fillers and false starts, then formats the text for the app you're in. Needs a Groq API key.
general.keySaveFailed: Couldn't save the key to the Keychain.
general.keyRemoveFailed: Couldn't remove the key from the Keychain.
general.keyInvalid: That key isn't valid. Check it and try again.
general.keyUnreachable: Couldn't reach Groq. Check your connection and try again.
general.cleanNeedsKeyAfter: , paste it in the API key field above, press Save, then turn on Magic Touch.

dictionary.customWordsEmpty: Add a name or term you want spelled a certain way, like Tauri or Nguyễn.
dictionary.replacementsEmpty: Add a short trigger like “btw” and Audibl writes “by the way” instead.
dictionary.deleteWordBody: Audibl will stop correcting this spelling in your transcripts.
dictionary.deleteReplacementBody: Audibl will stop inserting “{{value}}” when you say it.

history.empty: Press your shortcut and speak — your last 10 transcripts land here.

advanced.startHiddenTip: Open to the menu bar without showing this window. Needs the menu bar icon.
advanced.launchOnStartupTip: Start Audibl automatically when you log in.
advanced.showMenuBarIconTip: Show Audibl in the menu bar. When hidden, reopen Audibl from Launchpad or Finder.
advanced.removeFillerWordsTip: Removes fillers like “um”, “uh”, “ờ”, “ừm” and repeated stutters. Done on this Mac.
advanced.interfaceLanguageTip: Changes the app's text only. Speech is always detected automatically as English or Vietnamese.

onboarding.headline: Set up Audibl to type what you say

microphone.title: Allow microphone access
microphone.body: Audibl listens only while you hold or toggle your shortcut. Your voice is transcribed on this Mac.

accessibility.title: Allow Accessibility access
accessibility.body: Audibl needs Accessibility to detect your shortcut from any app and to paste the text where you are typing. Turn on Audibl in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility.

model.title: Download the speech model
model.body: Audibl needs a {{size}} speech model. It downloads once and then runs fully offline.

errors.network: The download was interrupted. Check your connection and retry; it will resume where it stopped.
errors.stalled: The download stopped receiving data. Retry to resume.
errors.checksum: The downloaded file was damaged. Retry to download it again.
errors.disk_space: Not enough disk space. Free up about 2 GB and retry.
errors.server: The download server returned an error. Try again later.
errors.io: The model couldn't be saved. Retry.
